method: Opened actual LeoCAD views in labelled browser review sheets; examined home composition, front elevation and site plan.
observations: Three repeated gable roof bays have blue glazing along one pitch of each bay.
The detached banded stack and spare work yard support the industrial character; the roofs are symmetric gables, not asymmetric sawtooth construction.
revisions: Changed all-blue roof slopes to contrasting opaque/glazed pitches.
scope: Exterior composition review; hidden interior interfaces and physical strength are not certified.
